name: PIE
recent: PIE 的子公司于11月20日获得一份价值 US$99.82 million 的 AI 服务器相关产品组装订单。公司同时出现大股东与董事的股权变动申报，并公布了截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩。
notable: 子公司获得价值 US$99.82 million 的 AI 服务器相关产品组装订单。
公司公布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩。
大股东 Pan Global Holding Co. Ltd 与 Pan-International Industrial Corporation 在10月至11月间多次申报股权变动。
risks: 独立非执行主席 Lim Chien Ch'eng 于11月24日以每股 RM1.550 增持10,000股。
大股东在10月至11月间多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 截至2026年9月30日的季度营收为 MYR 212.482 million，环比增长18.0%，同比增长3.7%；净利为 MYR 11.525 million，净利率5.4%，净利环比增长202.7%，同比增长156.5%。

recent_en: PIE's subsidiary secured a US$99.82 million order on Nov 20 for assembly of AI server-related products. The company also saw substantial shareholder and director interest change filings, and released quarterly results for the period ended Sept 30, 2026.
notable_en: A subsidiary secured a US$99.82 million order for assembly of AI server-related products.
The company released quarterly results for the period ended Sept 30, 2026.
Substantial shareholders Pan Global Holding Co. Ltd and Pan-International Industrial Corporation filed multiple changes in interest between October and November.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Chairman Lim Chien Ch'eng acquired 10,000 shares at RM1.550 per share on Nov 24.
Substantial shareholders filed multiple changes in interest between October and November.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended Sept 30, 2026, revenue was MYR 212.482 million, up 18.0% QoQ and 3.7% YoY; net income was MYR 11.525 million with a 5.4% net margin, up 202.7% QoQ and 156.5% YoY.
